text.en: Strata brings Qwen three point eight Flash Next to your own PC. Private, fast, and open source.

text.zh: Strata 让你在个人电脑上本地运行 Qwen 3.8 Flash Next，私密、快速、开源。

items.body:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1", api_key="local")
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="strata",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Estimate VRAM for IQ3_XXS"}],
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
